risk_description: Warfarin + Ibuprofen increases bleeding risk due to antiplatelet effects and gastric irritation
interaction_result: Monitor INR closely. Consider alternative analgesic (paracetamol). If combined use necessary reduce warfarin dose by 10-20%.

risk_description: Warfarin + Diclofenac significantly increases bleeding risk
interaction_result: Avoid combination if possible. If necessary monitor INR weekly and reduce warfarin dose.

risk_description: Warfarin + Aspirin increases bleeding risk
interaction_result: Use with caution. Monitor for signs of bleeding. Consider reducing aspirin to 75mg daily.

risk_description: Warfarin + Amoxicillin can increase INR due to alteration of gut flora (vitamin K production)
interaction_result: Monitor INR 3-5 days after starting antibiotic. May need temporary warfarin dose reduction.

risk_description: Losartan + Spironolactone increases risk of hyperkalemia
interaction_result: Monitor serum potassium closely. Avoid in patients with baseline K+ >5.0 mmol/L. Check K+ within 1 week of starting combination.

risk_description: Lisinopril + Spironolactone significantly increases hyperkalemia risk
interaction_result: Same as above - monitor potassium closely. Consider alternative diuretic (hydrochlorothiazide).

risk_description: Enalapril + Spironolactone increases hyperkalemia risk
interaction_result: Monitor potassium. Avoid in CKD Stage 4-5.

risk_description: Metformin + Furosemide increases lactic acidosis risk in dehydrated patients
interaction_result: Monitor renal function. Hold metformin if severe dehydration or acute illness. Ensure adequate hydration.

risk_description: Atenolol + Insulin Regular can mask hypoglycemia symptoms
interaction_result: Educate patient on hypoglycemia without tremor/palpitations. Monitor blood glucose more frequently.

risk_description: Atenolol + Metformin - beta blocker may mask hypoglycemia in diabetics
interaction_result: Educate patient. Prefer cardioselective beta blockers (bisoprolol) in diabetics.

risk_description: Bisoprolol + Metformin - less masking effect due to cardioselectivity
interaction_result: Monitor blood glucose. Educate on atypical hypoglycemia symptoms.

risk_description: Fluoxetine + Tramadol increases serotonin syndrome risk
interaction_result: Avoid combination. If necessary use lowest tramadol dose (50mg) and monitor for agitation confusion tachycardia hyperthermia.

risk_description: Tramadol + Nevirapine - CYP450 interaction may alter tramadol metabolism
interaction_result: Monitor pain control. May need tramadol dose adjustment.

risk_description: Metronidazole + Warfarin significantly increases INR and bleeding risk
interaction_result: Avoid combination if possible. If necessary reduce warfarin dose by 30-40% and monitor INR every 2-3 days.

risk_description: Cotrimoxazole + Warfarin increases bleeding risk
interaction_result: Reduce warfarin dose. Monitor INR closely.

risk_description: Ciprofloxacin + Atorvastatin increases statin levels (rhabdomyolysis risk)
interaction_result: Consider statin dose reduction or temporary discontinuation during antibiotic course.

risk_description: Ciprofloxacin + Warfarin increases INR
interaction_result: Monitor INR. May need warfarin dose reduction during antibiotic treatment.

risk_description: Ibuprofen + Metformin - NSAIDs can reduce renal clearance of metformin
interaction_result: Monitor renal function. Use lowest effective NSAID dose for shortest duration.

risk_description: Ibuprofen + Lisinopril reduces antihypertensive effect
interaction_result: Monitor blood pressure. Consider alternative analgesic (paracetamol) for chronic use.

risk_description: Diclofenac + Enalapril reduces blood pressure lowering effect
interaction_result: Monitor BP. Avoid chronic NSAID use in hypertensive patients.

risk_description: Hydrochlorothiazide + Losartan may cause excessive blood pressure lowering
interaction_result: This is intentional combination therapy. Monitor BP and electrolytes.

risk_description: Amlodipine + Simvastatin increases statin exposure
interaction_result: Limit simvastatin dose to 20mg daily when combined with amlodipine.

risk_description: Levothyroxine + Ferrous Sulfate reduces thyroid hormone absorption
interaction_result: Separate administration by at least 4 hours. Take levothyroxine on empty stomach 30-60 min before iron.

risk_description: Levothyroxine + Calcium Carbonate reduces thyroid hormone absorption
interaction_result: Separate by 4 hours.

risk_description: TLE (Efavirenz) + Fluconazole - CYP450 interaction
interaction_result: Monitor for increased efavirenz toxicity. May need dose adjustment.

risk_description: TLD (Dolutegravir) + Fluconazole - minimal interaction
interaction_result: Generally safe combination. Monitor clinical response.

risk_description: Ceftriaxone + Amlodipine - no significant interaction but monitor renal function
interaction_result: Safe combination. Routine monitoring.

risk_description: Prednisolone + Metformin - steroids increase blood glucose
interaction_result: Monitor blood glucose closely. May need increased metformin dose or additional diabetic medication.

risk_description: Prednisolone + Insulin Regular - steroids cause insulin resistance
interaction_result: Increase insulin dose by 20-50%. Monitor blood glucose 4-6 times daily.

risk_description: Furosemide + Losartan can cause excessive blood pressure drop and acute kidney injury
interaction_result: Start with low doses. Monitor BP blood pressure and renal function. Ensure adequate hydration.

risk_description: Spironolactone + Calcium Carbonate - no direct interaction but monitor potassium
interaction_result: Calcium binders don't affect potassium but monitor electrolytes in CKD patients.

risk_description: Erythropoietin + Ferrous Sulfate - iron is required for EPO effectiveness
interaction_result: This is synergistic clinically. Ensure adequate iron stores (ferritin >100) before starting EPO.

risk_description: Calcitriol + Calcium Carbonate increases risk of hypercalcemia
interaction_result: Monitor serum calcium monthly. Target calcium 8.5-10.2 mg/dL. Hold calcitriol if Ca >10.5.

risk_description: Metformin + Cotrimoxazole increases risk of lactic acidosis
interaction_result: Monitor renal function and lactate. Hold metformin if severe infection.

risk_description: Haloperidol + Lisinopril can cause excessive blood pressure lowering
interaction_result: Monitor BP. Start with low haloperidol dose.

risk_description: Diazepam + Paracetamol - paracetamol may increase sedation
interaction_result: Generally safe. Warn patient about increased drowsiness.

risk_description: Amitriptyline + Warfarin increases bleeding risk
interaction_result: Monitor INR. Amitriptyline may potentiate anticoagulant effect.

risk_description: Artemether-Lumefantrine + TLE (Efavirenz) - complex CYP450 interaction
interaction_result: Monitor for treatment failure. May need increased artemether dose or alternative antimalarial.

risk_description: Beclometasone + Fluconazole - azole increases steroid exposure
interaction_result: Generally safe at standard doses. Monitor for steroid side effects (oral thrush hoarseness).

risk_description: Metoclopramide + Metronidazole both cause CNS effects
interaction_result: Warn patient about drowsiness and confusion. Avoid driving.
